title: Can I add new default bodies to MZ's Generator?

posts.author: Fievol
posts.body:
So I may have failed to find a post or thread that exactly talks about what I mean. But I was experimenting with the character generator in MZ cause I wanted to add more default bodies than just Male, Female, and Kid. At first I wanted to see if it was actually really easy, so I made new files in the game folder > generator > Face, TVD, SV, etc. It was basically just a copy of the Male sprite sheets base folder for each sprite set. I named it something different and kept each copy named the same. But that didn't work. So I guess it isn't that easy.
Anyone know of a way to edit the files in order to allow me to just slot in more sprite folders in the generator, other than Male, Female, and Kid? Or is there a really common plugin I haven't found? I could see that being the case. I appreciate the help a lot.
To be clear, my end goal was to add more of these tabs if possible. I'm not new to coding, just RMMZ.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
The short answer is no.
You cannot modify the editor.
There are 3rd party chargen tools you can use, or you can just take the parts yourself and assemble them in a image editing tool.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: I don't think so. You'll have to swap the folder name before opening.
